outputs.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart showing median promoter-state frequencies across many finely binned Pol II ChIP-seq levels (continuous trend across the x-axis, n=5912 promoters aggregated into bins). This functions like a continuous distribution/trend plot rather than a simple few-bar comparison; overlaying thousands of individual promoter values per bin would be unreadable, so it is treated like an exempt line/area plot.

The single-molecule stack itself displays every individual DNA molecule (one row per molecule, 2952 molecules) with its own methylation pattern; the color sidebar summarizing state frequencies is directly derived from and shown alongside these individual data rows, so individual data points are present.

Same representation as panel A: a stacked bar/area chart of median state frequencies across finely binned Pol II ChIP-seq levels (n=6122 promoters), functioning as a continuous trend plot exempt from individual point overlay.
Same representation as panel B: individual molecules (2871 rows) are directly displayed in the single-molecule stack alongside the summary sidebar.
Boxplots depicting PIC occupancy distributions; box plots are exempt from requiring separately overlaid individual points as they already convey the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers).
Boxplots depicting Pol II occupancy distributions; box plots are exempt from requiring separately overlaid individual points as they already convey the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers).
